newsitem.title: YEMEN: Yemen awards Alcatel $3mln expansion deal.
newsitem.headline: Yemen awards Alcatel $3mln expansion deal.

text.p: Yemen has awarded France's Alcatel two deals worth 293 million Yemeni rials ($3 million) to improve the country's telephone network, official sources said on Wednesday.
The deals are part of a 2 billion rial ($20 million) scheme to upgrade its telecommunications and Internet network.
They were signed by the state-run Telecommunications Company and the French telephone giant on Tuesday, they added. Yemen's TCC will fund both projects.
The first scheme will expand the telephone network in al-Tahrir area, the commercial heart in the capital Sanaa. The other will install new telephone lines between Sanaa and other cities.
Earlier this year, Alcatel won a $50 million contract to modernise the telecommunications infrastructure in the southern city of Aden.
